metadata.description: Claude Code skills for jPipe, the justification / assurance-case language.

plugins.name: jpipe-skills
plugins.description: EXPERIMENTAL, not part of jPipe core. Skills for reviewing and operating jPipe justification models (.jd). One reviews a single model's argument; one compares elements across a corpus for duplicated claims, splits and available refinements. These review an argument a human wrote; they do not write assurance cases.
